summary: Plan r1 is committed (AnsibleSpecs 0b5f8d0). It is cross-cutting, with five phases: the D7 amendment, ArgoCDDeploy metrics plus additionalUrls, PrometheusDeploy standing rules and no-resolve routing for the events, KubeCoderDeploy record-only promote, and GitSyncDeploy prune. attachments/standing-alerts.md defines the standing-alert behaviour, and verification.json maps R1-R5 in 14 criteria. One design call is visible in Not in scope and the attachment: apps Argo CD does not auto-sync (only argocd-prd today) get no standing out-of-sync alert.
